**Definition** (free text, with reference(s), please. PubMed ID format is PMID:XXXXXX)
A conserved retinal ganglion cell orthotype whose transcriptomic profile groups together ON parasol RGCs from primate foveal and peripheral retina with their molecularly homologous mouse α RGC subtype (ON‑transient α RGC, C41) (Hahn et al., 2023; Tran et al., 2019).
